summary: This video showcases a full Toxin team setup against the Season 8 endgame boss Mekkatorque, dealing over 1.45 billion damage to achieve an S rank. The core damage dealer of the composition is Serpentemis, who outputs the vast majority of the team's total damage. Full hero stat priorities, gear profiles, and precise skill timings are detailed to ensure optimal uptime and debuff application.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.note: Carried the majority of the team's DPS (over 962M damage); build for full damage with ideally 160+ Accuracy.

heroes.name: Twitch
heroes.note: Contributed over 250M damage; build with full Accuracy and Skill Haste.

heroes.note: Build full Attack and aim for 160+ Accuracy.

teams.note: Achieved 1.459B total damage. Skill recast times are synced to 17.2000s across heroes, with initial casts offset around 11.1999s to 11.6000s for smooth skill rotation.

tips: Aim for at least 160+ Accuracy on debuffers like Serpentemis and Sleight against Mekkatorque.
Synchronize ultimate recast timings to 17.2 seconds to maintain consistent skill rotations throughout the fight.
Focus full Skill Haste and Accuracy on Twitch to keep Toxin application rolling smoothly.
